title.narrative: Building Resilience through Improved Food and Nutrition Security in KP, Punjab and Baluchistan

description.narrative: Objective/Impact:To contribute to building resilience through improved food and nutrition security among small-holder farming households in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Baluchistan, and Punjab provinces of PakistanOutcomes:Improved access to and consumption of healthy and diverse diets among smallholder households by employing adaptive and transformative capacities to develop robustness against climatic shocks and stresses,Improved nutrition situation through Nutrition-awareness among population particularly during the 1000-days window of opportunity and through improved WASH facilities/services,Improved nutrition situation of women (of reproductive age) and children (under 5 years of age) to save lives, ensure good health and ability to work,Resilience of at-risk communities and local authorities enhanced through operationalization of supporting strategies that enable them to anticipate, better prepare for and respond to natural disasters.

The project aims to improve the Food and Nutrition situation for vulnerable communities, especially women and children through multi-sectoral approaches to improve the food and nutrition situation and increase the resilience of at-risk communities through strategies that enable anticipation and preparedness. Activities will be implemented to improve access to and consumption of health and diverse diets, to increase nutrition awareness and improved WASH facilities as well as through supporting disaster preparedness strategies. The project will be implemented in Shangla, Jhal Magsi and Muzaffargarh.
